maps.title: SB classes 2026 · Class 01 · Safety Under Krishna's Arms

nodeData.note: SB 1.14.35–36 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Continuing Yudhishthira's questions to the returning Arjuna, Prabhu explains why the Yadus live like the residents of Vaikuntha: Krishna and Balarama are with them. He traces the Lord's expansions from Balarama to the three Vishnus, then shows that this world is built to be unsafe, so real shelter, comfort and fearlessness are found only with Krishna. Questions cover the Brahman effulgence, the Lord's physical presence and the role of Jaya and Vijaya. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Prabhu recalls the setting: Yudhishthira is questioning Arjuna about his trip to Dwarka.

🎙 Prabhu at 04:57 (auto-transcript): “We are hearing Yudhishthir Maharaj asking Arjuna about his trip to Dwarka. Arjuna had gone to Dwarka but failed to return within seven months. Yudhishthira Maharaj observed inauspicious omens within the environment, within society and surmised that most probably Lord Krishna…”

Arjuna stayed away seven months; seeing ill omens in nature and society, Yudhishthira guessed Krishna had left the world, and Arjuna came back looking unhappy. Still Yudhishthira first asks about all their relatives in Mathura and Dwarka.

🎙 Prabhu at 05:08 (auto-transcript): “Arjuna had gone to Dwarka but failed to return within seven months. Yudhishthira Maharaj observed inauspicious omens within the environment, within society and surmised that most probably Lord Krishna is no longer on this planet. From his observation, he understood this and…”
Yudhishthira describes the Yadus as happy as Vaikuntha's residents, because Krishna and Balarama dwell among them and guard them.

Prabhu explains from the purport that creation is one quarter material and three quarters spiritual, and that for this world the Lord expands as the Purusha avatars.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:13 (auto-transcript): “Sushala Prabhupada is explaining in the purport that there is the material universe and then there is the spiritual universe. In the totality of creation, one quarter is the material universe and three quarters is the spiritual universe. Ekpad Vibhuti is known as the material…”

Balarama is Krishna's first expansion, the same Supreme Lord, differing only in function: He assists and serves Krishna in His pastimes. — “So Lord Balaram is the servant god”

🎙 Prabhu at 08:16 (auto-transcript): “So our scriptures, they tell us, Lord Balaram, he is the first expansion. And Lord Krishna has many, many types of expansions, many types of incarnations. And so for the purpose of creating this material world, the Lord expands himself into the Purusha avatars. Or the…”

From Balarama come Vasudeva, Sankarshana, Pradyumna and Aniruddha, with functions such as pervading everything, ego, intelligence and mind. From Sankarshana comes Narayana, and from Him a second set of four.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:41 (auto-transcript): “So from Lord Balaram There comes Chaturvyuha, an expansion of the Lord Which we read many times There are four of them Vasudev, Sankarshan, Pradyumna and Aniruddha and each of these four have their own specific functions. Vasudev means he is pervading the entire universe and…”

From the second Sankarshana comes Maha-Vishnu, then Garbhodakashayi and Kshirodakashayi Vishnu, each a Supersoul at a different level.

🎙 Prabhu at 10:54 (auto-transcript): “and from the second Sankarshan then comes Mahavishnu otherwise also known as Karunadakashai Vishnu or the super soul of the entire material existence and it is from this Mahavishnu who is lying in the causal ocean as Lord Srila Prabhupada is mentioning here that in the causal…”

Lying in the causal ocean, Maha-Vishnu exhales universes from His pores as empty shells and draws them back in as He inhales, again and again.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:15 (auto-transcript): “Mahavishnu who is lying in the causal ocean as Lord Srila Prabhupada is mentioning here that in the causal ocean there are so many bubbles and these bubbles are different different universes. He is saying these universes they are floating on the ocean like bubbles. So it is…”

children.topic: Ananta holds universes like mustard seeds
children.note:
Garbhodakashayi Vishnu enters each shell, creates the Garbhodaka ocean from His perspiration, and lies on Ananta, the many-hooded serpent who holds all universes like mustard seeds. From His navel a lotus grows, and on it Brahma is born.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:29 (auto-transcript): “So when he expands in each of these empty shells of the universe Garbodakashaya Vishnu enters all of them in his individual capacity. In each shell, Garbhodakashai Vishnu is there. So Garbhodakashai Vishnu is the super soul of the universe. Maha Vishnu, macro level of the…”

Kshirodakashayi Vishnu lives on the ocean of milk above even Brahmaloka. When troubled, the demigods stand on its shore with Brahma; they cannot see the Lord, and only Brahma hears His instructions.

🎙 Prabhu at 14:43 (auto-transcript): “and then Garbhodakashai Vishnu expounds one final time as Shirodakashai Vishnu. Shirodakashai Vishnu within this universe. So we are looking at from Mahavishnu an empty shell comes out, then from that in that shell Garbhodakashai Vishnu enters and then when he enters the…”

Prabhu sums up: Maha-Vishnu is the Supersoul of all material existence, Garbhodakashayi of each universe, and Kshirodakashayi of every heart and atom — the same Supersoul Parikshit saw.

🎙 Prabhu at 17:14 (auto-transcript): “So Maha Vishnu super soul of material existence. Garbhutha Kashaya Vishnu super soul of the universe and Shirodha Kashaya Vishnu super soul in the heart. Present in each and every atom. So although we are looking at three expansions and we are looking at Krishna and his…”

All these expansions are one person. We are used to one soul in one body, so the spiritual reality of many forms and one soul is beyond our experience and causes confusion. — “spiritual world is many bodies one soul”

🎙 Prabhu at 17:29 (auto-transcript): “So although we are looking at three expansions and we are looking at Krishna and his expansion as Lord Balaram and then the Chaturvyoham but one thing we need to understand is is the same person. This is where so much confusion comes in because here in this world we are…”

Yudhishthira compares Dwarka to the ocean of milk, a Vaikuntha atmosphere within the material universe.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:58 (auto-transcript): “So therefore Maharaj Yudhishthir here is remembering the Shira Sagar and comparing the residence of Dwarka to this place, the ocean of milk. When the ocean of milk is the abode of the Lord, There is a Vaikuntha planet or a Vaikuntha atmosphere within this material universe.…”

Dhruvaloka is another spiritual planet here. As embassies in Nairobi follow their own country's rules, such places do not run under material laws.

🎙 Prabhu at 19:27 (auto-transcript): “There is another planet like this in our universe. That planet is known as Dhruvaloka. It is one of the Vaikuntha planets but it is here in the material world. Just like you have an embassy. So in Nairobi we have so many embassies. but the rules of chenya are not applicable…”

Dwarka was Vaikuntha on earth because Krishna and Balarama were there; Vrindavan, where He played, still does not function like the rest of the world.

🎙 Prabhu at 20:44 (auto-transcript): “Why? Because Lord Krishna was there and Lord Ananta were there. Wherever Lord Krishna is present, then that place is not different from the spiritual world. We look at Vrindavan, where Lord Krishna performed his pastimes. Even today, thousands of devotees go there because…”

Vaikuntha means free from fear; this world is always fearful. Even the comfortable worry how long their comfort will last, and our defending comes from fear. — “We are always fearful in this world.”

🎙 Prabhu at 21:26 (auto-transcript): “What is Vaikuntha? Vaikuntha means, Shra Prabhupada is mentioning here, a place that is free from fear. Kuntha is known as the material world. There is always fear. And this is always existing. Fear is always there. Our conditional life is characterized by eating, sleeping,…”

Many moved to Dubai for safety and prosperity, but when war broke out and it was attacked, thousands left in fear.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:23 (auto-transcript): “Many people would go to Dubai and they would think Dubai is safe, it's prosperous. Here Yudhishthira Maharaj is speaking about Dwaraka, how prosperous it is how safe it is and people would think oh Dubai is so safe so prosperous quality of life is so nice and so many people…”

Expecting not to be pricked in a forest of thorns is unintelligent; this world is designed to be unsafe. — “It's a forest of thorns.”

🎙 Prabhu at 23:27 (auto-transcript): “find a safe place because the world itself is designed to be unsafe you go into a forest of thorns and if you expect that oh i will not be pricked then that is not very intelligent It's a forest of thorns. You will be pricked somewhere. So this world is designed, this…”

Indraprastha was so opulent that Duryodhana was allured, yet Yudhishthira says only the Yadus are truly safe, because the Lord's arms protect them. Even a city far ahead in technology is not safe.

🎙 Prabhu at 24:34 (auto-transcript): “Otherwise even Indraprastha was a very opulent city. Very prosperous. Duryodhana also got allured by the prosperity of Indraprastha. But Yudhishthira Maharaj is saying no we may be materially prosperous but we are not safe. Who are safe? Yadavas are safe. They are materially…”

We crave permanence because it means safety. On Kipande Road at midnight people run, not walk; yet in this world we think we are safe in bodies that age, sicken and die.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:31 (auto-transcript): “Just walk on our Kipande road down here at midnight. Most people will not walk, they will run. We see it always, people running up and down because they know if we delay here, we will get robbed. So whenever we go to an unsafe place, we don't want to spend a second necessary…”

Prabhu cites Sukadeva Goswami: the deluded man trusts his soldiers — body, wife, children and clan — though he sees them all falling around him.

🎙 Prabhu at 27:24 (auto-transcript): “we think oh I am safely protected by my body Sukhdev Goswami mentions this The gross material is Even though he is seeing He does not see He thinks oh I will be protected By my soldiers Who are these soldiers Deha My body My body is protecting me Apatya and Kalatra, my sons…”

Where are our grandfathers and great-grandfathers? Relatives die all around, yet we think we are safe. Safety is not in wealth or a big clan but with Krishna and Balarama.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:34 (auto-transcript): “They are all falling. Where is our grandfather? Some people may have their grandfathers. Then where is our great grandfather? No longer. relatives dying left right center all around us but under the illusion we think we are safe Yudhishthira Maharaj here is saying safety is…”

The brothers come for the world's auspiciousness; Prabhu recalls Kaviraj Goswami calling them a rising sun and moon that dispel ignorance. — “auspiciousness can only be found”

🎙 Prabhu at 29:21 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj is saying both of them they're here for Mangalaya they're the ones who are bringing all auspiciousness. Kaviraj Goswami also he mentions in the beginning of Chaitanya Charita Amrita that these two brothers have come to dissipate. They are like the rising sun of…”

Prahlada says people take shelter of what is unworthy of shelter. Offered a ladder with missing rungs, you would refuse it; not knowing their interest lies in Vishnu, people climb such ladders. — “You'd say, no, I don't trust this ladder.”

🎙 Prabhu at 30:16 (auto-transcript): “Prahlad Maharaj knew this. He is saying Durasraya Durasraya means something that is not worthy of taking shelter. Just like if I was to give you a ladder to climb and that ladder was a rickety ladder right? that had a few rungs missing and didn't look like it could carry your…”

Those who struggle hope one day to tell interviewers how they got out of it. Our inherent nature seeks safety and comfort, and with them comes happiness.

🎙 Prabhu at 31:18 (auto-transcript): “everyone is looking for safety everyone is looking for comfort no one wants struggle those who are struggling they are going on with the hope that oh one day this struggle will stop one day I will make it one day the days of my struggle will be left behind and I can write in…”

When Kalayavana and Jarasandha attacked Mathura, Krishna built Dwarka in the ocean and moved everyone there overnight, staying behind with Balarama to fight. Dwarka could only be reached by flying in on 'Garuda Airways'. — “And so the Yadavas knew safety equals being with Krishna.”

🎙 Prabhu at 32:31 (auto-transcript): “The same families were there in Mathura and Lord Krishna, after killing Kamsa, he attracted attention of Kalayavana and Jarasandha. So Kalayavana came with his massive army to attack Mathura. That was the plan along with Jarasandha. and so Lord Krishna said okay Mathura…”

As Kunti prayed earlier, the Pandavas knew their prosperity and safety came from Krishna and begged Him not to go back to Dwarka.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:05 (auto-transcript): “We read earlier in the 8th chapter Kunti Maharani's prayers and where she is saying now that we are safe you are leaving us then we will not be safe anymore. You cannot leave us. Now that we seem that we are prosperous but actually this prosperity is because of you. Kunti…”

children.topic: Why fear when God is there?
children.note:
Like the bumper sticker, the Yadus lived without fear and no one could defeat them, because Krishna was with them. — “Why fear when God is there?”

🎙 Prabhu at 37:13 (auto-transcript): “Some people put a bumper sticker on the car. Why fear when God is there? So the Yadavas were living by this. There was no fear because Krishna was there. They knew nothing can happen to us. And indeed the Yadavas were invincible. Nobody could defeat them. Nobody could…”

What the world searches for and fails to find, Yudhishthira gives the clue to: to be safe and happy we must take shelter of Krishna and live with Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:12 (auto-transcript): “For us, it means if we want to be safe, if we want to be comfortable, if we want to enjoy, then we also have to connect ourselves to Lord Krishna. We also have to take shelter of Lord Krishna. We also have to live with Lord Krishna. What everyone else is looking for and being…”

Questions and comments at the end of class.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:56 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, if there are any questions or comments. Yes. So the question is, what is Brahman infurgence? Brahman infurgence is light. What it looks like, it looks like light. It is light. You know, but this light is not glaring light.”

children.topic: Q1 · What is the Brahman effulgence?
children.note:
A devotee asks what the Brahman effulgence is.

🎙 Prabhu at 39:20 (auto-transcript): “So the question is, what is Brahman infurgence? Brahman infurgence is light. What it looks like, it looks like light. It is light. You know, but this light is not glaring light. It's not like, oh, you can't look at it. No, it's very soothing, but it's bright everywhere. It's…”

It is light, not glaring but soothing, like Nairobi's clear sky lit everywhere; it comes from Krishna's body. Brahman, the Lord's impersonal feature, is not the same as Brahma.

🎙 Prabhu at 39:28 (auto-transcript): “Brahman infurgence is light. What it looks like, it looks like light. It is light. You know, but this light is not glaring light. It's not like, oh, you can't look at it. No, it's very soothing, but it's bright everywhere. It's like the sky. Right now we have a clear sky here…”

children.topic: A green parrot in a green tree
children.note:
Souls in the Brahman do not lose identity. Like a green parrot in a green tree, they are hard to see from afar but still there, floating in that sky. — “The Vedas, they explain just like a green parrot sitting in a green tree.”

🎙 Prabhu at 41:25 (auto-transcript): “So in that light, the souls, and that's what Krishna explains in the Gita, that even if we go into Brahman, we don't become identity-less. We don't lose our identity. The Vedas, they explain just like a green parrot sitting in a green tree. So, if you try to look for the…”

children.topic: Q2 · Is His physical presence needed?
children.note:
Is one safe only when the Lord is physically present?

🎙 Prabhu at 42:50 (auto-transcript): “So does the physical presence of the Lord only give safety? And if someone is not physically present with the Lord, are they safe? So here, in terms of the narrative, the Pandavas of course were always connected with the Lord. they have taken shelter, they were eternally…”

The Pandavas were always connected with Krishna, but His physical absence is painful. The Pandavas praised the Yadus for having a city built by Him, and the Yadus praised the Pandavas because Krishna sat in their assembly.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:19 (auto-transcript): “So here, in terms of the narrative, the Pandavas of course were always connected with the Lord. they have taken shelter, they were eternally associated with the Lord. But in terms of the narrative, because Yudhishthir Maharaj is already having that conception in his head that…”

Why did the Vaikuntha gatekeepers, born as demons, worship demigods rather than the Lord?

🎙 Prabhu at 45:43 (auto-transcript): “So why did the gatekeepers of Vaikuntha, Jay and Vijay, when they came here as demons, why didn't they worship Lord Krishna, why did they worship the demigods? Why did they worship Lord Krishna indirectly by worshiping the demigods?”

They came to be the Lord's enemies, and one does not approach one's enemy, so Hiranyakashipu went to Brahma for power. Such things — like the meeting of Rama and Parashurama — are all part of the Lord's pastimes, understood through the acharyas.

🎙 Prabhu at 46:29 (auto-transcript): “Because they were fulfilling a particular character, a particular role. They were enemies of Lord Krishna. Why would you go to your enemy? Hiranyakashipu decided, oh Brahma is the greatest living being in this universe, so I will approach him. he had enmity with Vishnu he is…”

maps.title: SB classes 2026 · Class 02 · The Visa to Vaikuntha

nodeData.note: SB 3.15.13 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Brahma begins to answer the frightened demigods by describing the spiritual world, starting with how the four Kumaras crossed every covering of the universe and entered Vaikuntha. Prabhu explains that they could do so because they were amala-atma, free of the mentality of being lord and enjoyer, while we suffer like visitors overstaying a visa in a temporary world. The visa home, he says, is purity gained through hearing, chanting, remembering and worship. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The demigods come to Brahma because a darkness spreading through the universe has stopped all their work, and they suspect it comes from Diti's embryo.

🎙 Prabhu at 03:37 (auto-transcript): “We are hearing the response of Lord Brahma to the demigods. The demigods approached Lord Brahma because they saw a darkness spreading throughout the entire universe. and they went to Lord Brahma to find out the source of this darkness because that darkness had stopped their…”

To relieve their anxiety, Brahma first describes the spiritual world, before telling the back story of Diti's sons Hiranyaksha and Hiranyakashipu. Simply hearing of that world frees one from anxiety.

🎙 Prabhu at 04:37 (auto-transcript): “And therefore, Lord Brahma began narrating a description of the spiritual world. Just by hearing about the spiritual world, one can become free from anxieties. The demigods, they were under anxiety. So much darkness everywhere, all their work had stopped. To relieve their…”

To describe it he must have seen it. Born into total darkness, Brahma heard two words, understood he should perform austerity, and after long austerities the Lord, pleased, shook his hand — and Brahma experienced the spiritual world.

🎙 Prabhu at 05:51 (auto-transcript): “When did Lord Brahma see the spiritual world? For him to describe the spiritual world means he had to have had experience of the spiritual world. So we read from the previous canto Lord Brahma when he was born he was also surrounded by darkness just like this darkness that's…”
Brahma tells how his first sons, the four Kumaras, travelled through the universe and, being free of contamination, entered the spiritual sky and its Vaikuntha planets.

Asked to populate the universe, the Kumaras refused. By yoga they stopped their bodies at five years old, though they were the first-born of creation.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:58 (auto-transcript): “But these four sons they refused. They disobeyed the order of Brahma. They said no we are not going to do this. And they were highly elevated in yoga. And so by their yogic power, they stopped their bodies from aging. So they stopped the body when it was just five years old.…”

Being lighter than the lightest, they travelled everywhere. The universe has coverings of earth, water, fire, air and ether, each far thicker than the last, yet the Kumaras needed no drill or spaceship to pass through. — “They didn't drill through these coverings”

🎙 Prabhu at 09:21 (auto-transcript): “This material universe has many layers of covering. So there is the universe itself and then the covering that comes on top is earth. And then seven times thicker than the diameter of the universe is this covering of earth. and seven times thicker than the covering of earth…”

They crossed by yogic power and because they were amala-atma — pure. Nations send rovers to Mars and the moon, but no machine reaches the spiritual world, because it too is pure.

🎙 Prabhu at 10:29 (auto-transcript): “and number two, because they were Amala Atmana. Amala Atmana means, Mala means contamination. And Amala means no contamination, pure. Because they were completely pure, they could transport themselves from the material universe to the spiritual universe. It is not possible.…”

children.topic: Not a shower and fresh clothes
children.note:
The contamination is not on the body but in our mentality and consciousness. — “no this is not the contamination we are talking about”

🎙 Prabhu at 11:47 (auto-transcript): “I'll take a nice shower put on fresh clothes and then I can go no this is not the contamination we are talking about The contamination is of our mentality, our consciousness. Shra Prabhupada explains in the introduction to the Bhagavad Gita that our material existence here is…”

Citing Srila Prabhupada's introduction to the Gita, Prabhu says material life is defined by these two ideas. The Kumaras were free of them; as long as we want to enjoy, we stay where that desire can be fulfilled.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:10 (auto-transcript): “Shra Prabhupada explains in the introduction to the Bhagavad Gita that our material existence here is defined by two types of consciousness. I am the Lord and I am the enjoyer. The Kumaras, they were free from this. They were free from this consciousness of I am the Lord and…”

We want to enjoy and be lords here, but this world is not eternal. A visa to America lasts only so many days; overstay it and you live in anxiety, as with the ICE raids Prabhu mentions.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:17 (auto-transcript): “But there is a problem which Lord Brahma is speaking about over here. The spiritual world is Vaikuntha. This world is Kuntha, the opposite. So although we want to live here, to enjoy here, to be the Lord here, there is a problem and that problem is this world is not eternal…”

Our nature is eternal, full of knowledge and bliss, but here we receive a body that is temporary, ignorant and without bliss, and we try to make it permanent.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:03 (auto-transcript): “We come here, we are eternal. We seek eternity. Our nature is sat, chit, ananda. Eternal, full of knowledge and blissful. But when we come here, we get a body. Because this is the material world, we have to stay in a body. We come here, we get a body and that body is asat, it…”

Prabhu shares a reflection he heard: apart from a mother's milk, nothing good comes out of the body, and without skin people would run away — yet illusion makes us spend so much time caring for it.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:46 (auto-transcript): “I was hearing recently, if you sit and you introspect and you analyze, if you look at our bodies, there is nothing good that comes out of the body. Male body, nothing good at all. Female body, milk comes out, that is okay. But anything else apart from that, nothing good. We…”

children.topic: A place of misery, and temporary
children.note:
Krishna says every planet up to Brahmaloka is a place of misery and repeated birth. Even if someone found a cure for the misery, it would not last.

🎙 Prabhu at 17:30 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna tells us in the Gita that from the planet of the demigods Brahma Lok down to the lowest planet all are places of misery and what is this misery? this misery is punar janma this misery is repeated birth repeated birth so in the previous verse”

Defending is our greatest concern because this is not our place. Huge industries research how to stop birth, death, old age and disease — all because we are anxious. — “We are foreigners here.”

🎙 Prabhu at 19:19 (auto-transcript): “We are always thinking, we are always under anxiety because it's not our place. We are visitors here. We are foreigners here. But we are trying to become natives. That is the problem. We are actually natives of the spiritual world. We belong in the spiritual world. The world…”

The Kumaras were in pure goodness, not ordinary goodness. Material goodness is overtaken in turn by passion and ignorance, and knowledge brings a sense of superiority that binds again, so we must transcend all three modes.

🎙 Prabhu at 20:52 (auto-transcript): “and so therefore the Kumaras they could go to the spiritual world because they were amala atmana they were free from this contamination and illusion that we are these bodies, I am the lord I am the enjoyer, they were free from all this, they were situated in the mode of…”

Brahma says the Vaikunthas are worshipped by every planet. All other places share the same anxieties.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:13 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada is mentioning These anxieties are birth, death, old age disease. And not only that, the Vaikuntha planets are worshippable by all planets in this world. Just like we hear many times people dream of the America dream, isn't it? Everyone wants to go to America…”

People dream of America as safe and secure, then hear of random shootings and cars driven into crowds; no place in this world is safe.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:27 (auto-transcript): “Just like we hear many times people dream of the America dream, isn't it? Everyone wants to go to America and stay in America because it's such a great country. So much facility, so much enjoyment, so much security, etc., etc. I don't know how much of that is true. I have…”

Indra watches who performs horse sacrifices; when someone nears a hundred, alarms go off and he intervenes, as he will with Prithu and Bali Maharaj. Heaven also ends when piety runs out. — “You can't have my job, he will stop it.”

🎙 Prabhu at 24:51 (auto-transcript): “Demigods are also always anxious. We find from the scriptures we hear, Lord Indra, he is always monitoring who is performing sacrifices. Who is applying for my job? Because if you do 100 sacrifices, ashrameda yagya, then you get the post of Indra. So he is always monitoring.…”

Like owning an iPhone but wanting the newest one, the demigods have far more enjoyment than us yet still aspire for Vaikuntha.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:40 (auto-transcript): “We know this phenomenon We may have an iPhone But it is not the latest iPhone We want the latest one Not the one that we have Similarly demigods although they have all enjoyment much much greater than here Still they aspire for Vaikuntha because the enjoyment in Vaikuntha…”

children.topic: Why Brahma describes it in detail
children.note:
Hearing the description creates a desire to go and reduces our desire to stay. Even demigods want human birth to hear about Vaikuntha.

🎙 Prabhu at 27:07 (auto-transcript): “And we will hear Lord Brahma giving the description of Vaikuntha planets When we hear these descriptions we also desire to go That is why the description is there Otherwise Lord Brahma could have said yes okay the spiritual world is there no description and just mentioned…”

The way to Vaikuntha is a human body engaged in devotional service, which clears the heart's contamination. — “That visa is become Amal Atmana.”

nodeData.note: SB 1.14.43 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Seeing Arjuna's sorrow, Yudhishthira keeps questioning him, and Prabhu shows how the Pandavas' grief reveals an attachment to Krishna far deeper than worldly ties. Yudhishthira's question about eating before feeding the old and the young opens a picture of saintly rule, where brahmanas, cows, women, children and elders were protected so everyone could fulfil the purpose of life. Prabhu contrasts this with today's selfishness and presents Krishna consciousness, and prasadam distribution, as the way back to that culture. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Arjuna returns after seven months in Dwarka with a sad, dejected face; as we ask 'what's wrong?' when we see such a face, Yudhishthira questions him.

🎙 Prabhu at 02:51 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthir Maharaj is asking Arjuna questions Arjuna having spent seven months in Dwaraka and returned to Hastinapur and seeing Arjuna's face Arjuna had a face that wasn't showing any joy and so seeing the sad dejected face of Arjuna Yudhishthir Maharaj is asking what…”

Narada had told Yudhishthira to prepare: when Krishna departs, the Pandavas too should get ready to leave. The omens told him the time had come, yet it was very hard to process.

🎙 Prabhu at 04:12 (auto-transcript): “Narad Muni in the previous chapter when he had met Yudhishthira Maharaj he said you prepare yourselves and when the time comes you will know that Lord Krishna has gone and then you should also prepare to leave. So Yudhishthira Maharaj, observing these various omens in the…”

The chapter is named for Krishna's disappearance, yet it never describes it; devotees so attached to Him do not speak of it. We hear only their reactions. — “They can't think of a moment without Lord Krishna.”

🎙 Prabhu at 04:54 (auto-transcript): “So here the chapter is called The Disappearance of Lord Krishna. but we have not heard anything about the disappearance of Lord Krishna. What are we hearing? We are hearing Yudhishthira Maharaj first speaking to his younger brother Bhima, noting to Bhima all the various…”

We only get glimpses of what the Pandavas felt; to understand fully we would need their attachment to Krishna. For them there is now no reason to stay on earth.

🎙 Prabhu at 06:35 (auto-transcript): “So this chapter and the next chapter is when Arjuna will speak and he speaks with very much heaviness in the heart we cannot imagine such a situation we are only getting glimpses of it from what Vyasadeva has written for us in the Srimad Bhagatam what Suta Goswami is…”

When one spouse dies the other often follows soon. Doctors reassure even very sick patients, because without the will to live even the best treatment fails.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:19 (auto-transcript): “Many times we hear of incidences wherein there is a couple and either the husband or the wife passes away and within a very short time, the other partner passes also away because of the intense attachment they shared. So there are documented instances for this. There is so…”

When Mahaprabhu ended His pastimes, Gadadhara Pandit, about the same age, was so attached that he became old overnight. — “he became old overnight.”

🎙 Prabhu at 08:43 (auto-transcript): “We hear in the Chaitanya Charitamrita, Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu concluded his pastimes. And when Gadadhar Pandit heard about this, he was also in a similar situation. It is described that Gadadhar Pandit became old overnight. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, he was on this earth for…”

Material attachment is mostly to looks, money or comfort; very few are attached to the person. The Pandavas' intense attachment brings intense separation.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:48 (auto-transcript): “We may have an experience similar, but attachments in this material world are not as intense as attachments to Lord Krishna. In the material world, attachments are based on external factors. Someone likes how someone else looks like or someone likes that person because they…”

children.topic: He wants to hear it from Arjuna
children.note:
Yudhishthira's heart is not ready; he has guessed the truth but wants Arjuna to confirm it. Pure devotees love Krishna more than their own lives, and He loves them the same way. — “The pure devotees, they love Krishna more than they love their own lives.”

🎙 Prabhu at 10:51 (auto-transcript): “How can we live without Krishna? Yudhishthira Maharaj is asking that to Arjuna. The heart is not ready to accept that Lord Krishna is no longer there. They know, Yudhishthira Maharaj could figure out, yes, this is all because most probably Lord Krishna is not there but he…”

While questioning Arjuna, Yudhishthira also highlights Vedic culture. Saintly kings — Yudhishthira, Parikshit, Lord Rama — shared certain elements in their rule.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:07 (auto-transcript): “But in the course of asking all these questions, Yudhishthira Maharaj is also highlighting various aspects of Vedic culture and society. We heard in the earlier chapters about the rule of Maharaj Yudhishthir And Vedic rule, the kings that were saintly They had certain…”

First the brahmanas and the cows; then women, children and the elderly, and in Yudhishthira's case also the sick and invalid.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:04 (auto-transcript): “What are these elements? Number one, protection of the brahmanas. Number two, protection of the cows. This is like non-negotiable. And then it expands further protection of the women, the children and the old, the elderly. And Yudhishthira Maharaj, Siddhartha Goswami is…”

Today we see the opposite: exploitation instead of protection. Then, failing to protect these people was unpardonable.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:46 (auto-transcript): “Whereas what we see now is totally the opposite. Instead of protection, there is exploitation. So therefore Yudhishthira Maharaj is asking these questions Because during that time, to fail to protect these elements of society was unpardonable. Here he is saying, Akshamam,…”
Yudhishthira asks whether Arjuna has done something unpardonable, such as eating before feeding the elders and children.

Householders were defined by charity: they fed children, elders, brahmanas and the sick first, and went out to call three times for anyone hungry. Mendicants took a little grain from a few homes, and an uninvited guest was treated like a demigod, so no one went hungry.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:06 (auto-transcript): “Krishna Prabhupada is mentioning that the householder would go out on the street and ask three times is anybody hungry please come we have some prasadam and each and every householder was doing this so therefore in the society there was no one who would go hungry we hear how…”

If a householder called out like that now, the whole village would come, find too little, rob the house and beat the family. Even feeding known guests daily is hard when everyone is struggling. — “the whole village will come”

🎙 Prabhu at 16:23 (auto-transcript): “we can't do this today if a householder goes outside and says is there anybody hungry please come the whole village will come and then they don't get enough food and then they will rob the entire house and beat the householder and beat his family members why did you call us…”

Those who do have means often say they worked hard and others should do the same. Yudhishthira's government and Vedic culture were not like that.

🎙 Prabhu at 17:53 (auto-transcript): “this that the general tendency is that I took this, whatever I have is because of my blood and sweat. If you want something like this, you also work. You'll also get. Do hard work. But Yiddish Shira Maharaj's government wasn't like that. Vedic culture wasn't like that. Vedic…”

Each group was protected for a purpose, not just for its own sake.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:16 (auto-transcript): “But Yiddish Shira Maharaj's government wasn't like that. Vedic culture wasn't like that. Vedic culture, first of all, gave preference to the Brahmanas. The Brahmanas were never working and the Brahmanas were never worried, oh, will we get to eat today? Sometimes there was…”

Maintained by the king and by householders with gifts of cows, land and grain, brahmanas never worried about food and focused on teaching the goal of human life.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:16 (auto-transcript): “But Yiddish Shira Maharaj's government wasn't like that. Vedic culture wasn't like that. Vedic culture, first of all, gave preference to the Brahmanas. The Brahmanas were never working and the Brahmanas were never worried, oh, will we get to eat today? Sometimes there was…”

Ghee is needed for sacrifice and milk sustains everyone and develops the fine brain tissue for higher understanding. In this spiritual communism no living being goes hungry — unlike today's 'that's your problem, not mine'.

🎙 Prabhu at 21:01 (auto-transcript): “And therefore they would protect the cows Because the cows would give milk Would give ghee And these are essential for maintaining Brahminical culture The ghee is needed for performing sacrifices that the Brahmanas would do The milk is needed to sustain everyone in society…”

Protected women raise good children, and so culture is maintained. Children are taught from early on not to waste the human form like animals.

🎙 Prabhu at 21:29 (auto-transcript): “So, apart from these two, then Yudhishthir Maharaj would ensure that the women are also protected because if the women are protected, they give good progeny. If there is good progeny, culture can be maintained. And so the women also are protected, not exploited. They were…”

Elders are protected so they can prepare for death, the final exam. If they must hunt for food, shelter and medicine, how can they think of Krishna? Many societies now send them to homes as a burden.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:48 (auto-transcript): “world. The elderly were also given protection so that they can prepare themselves for the final exam, death. We look at today's society, all these elements are struggling. Or worse, they are being exploited. In some African cultures, when a person is elderly, they say, no,…”

Dhritarashtra had tried to kill Yudhishthira and made the Pandavas suffer, yet after the war Yudhishthira cared for him as the family elder. — “he never held a grudge that”

🎙 Prabhu at 23:53 (auto-transcript): “He is showing by his own personal example How he took care of the elderly Dhritarashtra wanted to kill Yudhishthir Maharaj the same Dhritarashtra after the war Yudhishthira Maharaj was taking care of him as an elderly member of the family he never held a grudge that oh this…”

Today animals and trees are not protected.

🎙 Prabhu at 25:33 (auto-transcript): “And today we see what is being protected. Who is being protected? The animals are not being protected. Trees are not being protected. So many trees are being cut down every single day. For what? For making buildings. we need a factory to come here chop down the entire forest…”

Forests are cleared for buildings and factories, and then we are surprised the weather changes; people told Prabhu Nairobi used to be pleasant. There must be repercussions.

🎙 Prabhu at 25:43 (auto-transcript): “Trees are not being protected. So many trees are being cut down every single day. For what? For making buildings. we need a factory to come here chop down the entire forest and then we all become surprised oh why is it becoming hotter some people were telling me last week…”

Beyond material facilities, Yudhishthira's real protection was the chance to use human life to come to Krishna. Brahmanas taught in their homes so everyone could hear the scriptures and go back to Godhead.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:23 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj's entire kingdom everyone was free from anxiety because Yudhishthir Maharaj made sure that the purpose of human life that is put in the forefront. Yes, everyone was given their material facilities but the real protection was that they are able to utilize…”

Saintly kings knew Krishna maintains everyone and they were only caretakers, making His provisions available.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:15 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj understood that the real maintainer of everyone is Lord Krishna. Nityo nityanam chetanas chetananam Eko bahunam yo vidadattikaman Lord Krishna is the one who is providing. Lord Krishna is the one who is maintaining. So the saintly kings like Yudhishthira…”

Srila Prabhupada's example: the mother has no milk until the child is born, then it is there. Whoever the Lord sends here, their food is arranged.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:01 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada gives the example of a child being born as soon as the child is born there is milk in the breast of the mother before that there was no milk but as soon as the child is born immediately the milk is there so Lord Krishna has made provisions for every living…”

Srila Prabhupada's father left flour on the floor of his cloth shop at closing so the rats would eat it and not the cloth. Even rats and snakes were cared for. — “they eat the flour”

🎙 Prabhu at 29:39 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada mentioned in his childhood about his father his father had a textile shop there were clothes inside the shop and so closing time his father used to leave some flour on the floor for the rats so Srila Prabhupada asked why are we doing this? no they eat the…”

children.topic: Why take a life for the tongue?
children.note:
Srila Prabhupada strongly taught non-violence. If human life is only eating, sleeping, mating and defending like the animals, by what standard do we decide an animal need not live? Human life differs only in its chance for devotion.

🎙 Prabhu at 30:41 (auto-transcript): “And that is why Śrīla Prabhupāda was such a strong proponent of ahimsa, non-violence. He used to challenge people, why for the sake of your tongue you are taking the life of an animal? You can do without. What gives one person the right to take another person's life or…”

Today good manners surprise people and bad behaviour is expected, because brahmanas and leaders have failed to teach what human life is for.

🎙 Prabhu at 32:20 (auto-transcript): “nowadays there's no culture someone does something cultural and it's like wow where did you come from otherwise it's expected nobody has any culture nobody has any etiquette nobody has any manners so-called manners there are always so many articles and clips on the internet…”

Srila Prabhupada founded ISKCON to teach the point of human life. A body without a head is directionless; we provide the head. — “we give the head.”

🎙 Prabhu at 33:38 (auto-transcript): “He said, our society is a society of Brahmanas. If a body does not have a head, then that body is directionless. It doesn't know where to go, what to do. So Srila Prabhupada said, we give the head. We teach. We are hearing how Yudhishthir Maharaj's rule was. What was the main…”

A century ago people still had extended selfishness — the rich built schools, hospitals and wells in their villages. Now it is 'my money, only for me', not even for family or partner.

🎙 Prabhu at 34:46 (auto-transcript): “So, even if we look 100 years back, society was having extended selfishness. People would think about their families, people would make sure that the village or the tribe or the clan, they are all well done, settled. Those who are rich, they would go to their village. If…”

Krishna consciousness lifts us from selfishness to wanting everyone's highest good — the Vaishnava's compassion. Without Srila Prabhupada we would still fight over resources that are the Lord's. As we progress spiritually, Yudhishthira's sensitivities come automatically.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:03 (auto-transcript): “for Krishna consciousness we see Krishna consciousness means we come out from that selfish nature and come to the selfless platform where we are not just worried about ourselves but we are making sure trying that everyone can get the highest benefit this is the compassion of…”

🎙 Prabhu at 39:06 (auto-transcript): “I want to see an example the example is our temple everywhere there is an ISKCON temple we are doing the same we understand Krishna is the one who is giving everyone and so we have this program called Food for Life and you are the director for Food for Life So you know,…”

Arjuna was told to rise above mundane morality, yet society is dog-eat-dog; how do we understand this?

🎙 Prabhu at 41:21 (auto-transcript): “So his question is that Arjuna was told to go beyond mundane moralism and the way the society is there, it's dog-eat-dog. So how do we understand all this? Our culture is centred on Krishna, so its chaos need not touch us; when we engage the outside world, our duty is to teach how humans should live.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:54 (auto-transcript): “See, one thing is the Vedas that tell us what to do. But how to do it is the culture. So we have a culture. And that culture is centered around Krishna. nodeData.note: SB 10.3.9–10 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. On Janmashtami Prabhu explains why we speak of Krishna's appearance rather than His birth: we are forced to take birth, while He chooses everything, like the sun rising at will. He then tells the story from Kamsa's wedding-day rage to the midnight appearance and Vasudeva's journey to Gokul. The lesson is Vasudeva and Devaki's surrender: service to Krishna comes before every other obligation, and devotees request rather than demand. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Today is Krishna's appearance day. Prabhu asks the difference: birthdays are ours, appearance days are His.

🎙 Prabhu at 03:53 (auto-transcript): “So, as we all know, today is a very auspicious day. Today is the appearance day of Lord Krishna. We say appearance day, we don't say birthday. What is the difference between the two? The difference between a birthday and an appearance day. The difference is birthday we have,…”

children.topic: We are forced to take birth
children.note:
None of us chose our place, family, day, time or even name; given the choice people would pick Bezos, Zuckerberg, Musk or Ambani as parents. — “We can't choose our family.”

🎙 Prabhu at 04:40 (auto-transcript): “We have a birthday because we are forced to take birth. we come in this world and we have no choice as to which place we will take birth none of us here in the hall chose our place of birth we're forced to take place we're forced to take birth in whichever place our mothers…”

Krishna chooses His parents, day, time and place. Appearance means there is choice; He is under no force.

🎙 Prabhu at 06:37 (auto-transcript): “he celebrates appearance days. For the Lord it's totally the opposite. He chooses his parents, he chooses the day, he chooses the time, he chooses the place. No one can order the sun to rise late after a late night. And there are not 365 suns a year — the same sun returns, as the same Lord comes, performs pastimes and moves on, while we take different bodies.

nodeData.note: SB 10.41.50–51 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. On Janmashtami Prabhu describes Krishna's unsurpassed beauty and His freedom from work and need, then follows Krishna and Balarama into Mathura to the florist Sudama, who garlands them and their friends. Through Vidura's banana peels, Trivakra, the fruit seller and the poor brahmana Sudama, he shows that Krishna wants only our best, offered with love and not as a transaction. Sudama's prayer for unshakable devotion, friendship with devotees and transcendental compassion becomes the prayer for the day. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.note: · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. On Janmashtami Prabhu recalls how Srila Prabhupada celebrated the festival alone on the Jaladuta and then in a New York storefront, and gives the one secret behind it all: to become dear to Krishna, hear about Him. Through the brahmanas' wives, Rukmini and Lord Brahma's prayer he shows that the unconquerable Lord is conquered by submissive hearing, that bhakti is receiving rather than achieving, and that hearing invites us into Krishna's eternal party. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Prabhu says no one celebrates Janmashtami like ISKCON, and all of it comes from Srila Prabhupada's compassion. He goes back to the very first celebrations outside India.

And the very first Janmarshmi celebration that Srila Prabhupada celebrated outside of India, I think the mic is a bit, the very first…”

In the middle of the ocean, with no devotees, temple or deities, Srila Prabhupada gathered Captain Pandya and the crew, spoke to them for an hour, cooked, and served prasadam at midnight.

nodeData.note: SB 3.4.2 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. From Uddhava's account of the Yadu dynasty's end, Prabhu draws the lesson of intoxication — not only by liquor but by birth, wealth, learning and beauty. Through Nalakuvara and Manigriva, Digvijaya Pandit and Indra he shows how pride blocks devotion, and through Caitanya Mahaprabhu's ecstatic kirtan he presents the real intoxication: the holy name, reached by steady sadhana and good association. In the questions he discusses karma and wealth, staying humble with money, and the 'shortcut in the shortcut'. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Uddhava tells Vidura how the Yadu dynasty was destroyed by the Lord's will, compared in the verse to bamboos catching fire by friction. Prabhu notes the Lord's pastimes always serve many purposes at once.

Meeting Uddhava at Prabhasa, Vidura asks after Krishna's family. Uddhava, coming out of deep remembrance, has narrated Vrindavan, Mathura and Dwaraka and now says neither the Lord nor His family remain on earth — Gandhari's curse, the sages' curse and the Lord's wish all came together.

🎙 Prabhu at 03:22 (auto-transcript): “Vidura on his pilgrimage happened to meet Uddhava at Prabash Shetra and knowing Uddhava to be a very very dear associate of Lord Krishna Vidura is asking Uddhava how are the Yadavas, how is Lord Krishna's family and this brought about a deep meditative remembrance in Uddhava…”

The Yadavas were demigods and Krishna's own associates, so we should not see their drunken fight as an ordinary event. Still, the lesson for us is the danger of intoxication. — “They were simply following the orders of the Lord.”

🎙 Prabhu at 06:40 (auto-transcript): “The Yadavas, they were not ordinary people. They are Krishna's family. These are demigods and Krishna's own personal associates who came in that family. And so, as Śrīla Prabhupāda is also pointing out, they were simply following orders. We should not think that how did the…”

In this world everyone is intoxicated — with wealth, strength, beauty — and such intoxication makes spiritual progress very difficult.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:40 (auto-transcript): “not just intoxication by liquor here in this material world all of us we are intoxicated someone is intoxicated with possessing a lot of wealth or possessing a lot of strength or possessing beauty there's so many types of intoxication so we see when someone has this kind of…”

Kunti names four intoxicants — high birth, wealth, learning and beauty — that keep one from approaching the Lord with feeling, because He belongs to those who own nothing but Him. With wealth comes the sense of being someone, and pride builds.

Kuvera's two sons were promoted to associates of Lord Shiva, got great wealth, and went mad with it.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:24 (auto-transcript): “difficult to make advancement on the spiritual path. The two sons of Kuvira, Manigriva and Nala Kuvira, they were promoted to being associates of Lord Shiva and because of their promotion they got a lot of wealth and they became mad because of that wealth. So as they got the…”

Drinking and frolicking with girls in heavenly gardens, they stayed naked when Narada passed, while the girls covered themselves. Narada decides to give them special mercy and tells them it is all because of their wealth.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:03 (auto-transcript): “promotion these two boys they would go and visit the gardens in the heavenly planets and they would be surrounded by girls and they would be drinking and they would be enjoying with the girls in the gardens and one fine day Narad Muni out of his causeless mercy was passing by…”

Parikshit Maharaj allowed Kali slaughterhouses, bars, brothels and casinos, none of which existed in his kingdom; so he granted a fifth place. Wherever gold is, the other four soon follow, because money can be used to sin. — “fifth place he said where the people hoard gold”

Devotional service is joyful, so devotees sing, dance and roll — as drunkards do, except a drunkard does not know where or who he is. Mahaprabhu offers the real, positive intoxication.

Rupa Goswami compares us to jaundice patients who taste the sweet names as bitter — one round feels long and sixteen impossible. The cure is to keep taking the sweet medicine until the taste returns. — “one has to take more and keep on taking more.”

children.topic: What you do between birth and death
children.note:
Spending good karma on more sin binds one again; in Nairobi the poor eat meat only at weddings, the rich every day. Good karma is not enough — use it to come to Krishna consciousness, the seed that breaks the cycle. Narada made the brothers trees so they could sin no more.

children.note:

nodeData.note: SB 1.3.43 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Asked to speak on Srila Prabhupada, Prabhu starts from the verse calling the Bhagavatam a sun for the blind age of Kali, and shows Srila Prabhupada as the person Bhagavata who lived that vision. Through stories of Russia, Juhu, Shyamasundara's cigarette, the moon landing and the Kadamba garland, he shows how Srila Prabhupada saw the potential of places and people and saw Krishna face to face, and asks for loyalty to ISKCON, his body and the home he built for the whole world. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.note: SB 1.15.11 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Arjuna, grieving Krishna's departure, remembers how the Lord saved the Pandavas when Duryodhana sent Durvasa and his ten thousand disciples to them in exile after Draupadi had eaten. Prabhu tells the story of the akshaya-patra, the single grain Krishna ate, and other Durvasa episodes, then shows how the Pandavas were never separate from Krishna because they thought only of pleasing Him — and how we can make Krishna dearest again by serving Him with the tongue. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Arjuna recalls how Krishna rescued the Pandavas when Durvasa came with his disciples during their exile, and how one bit of food Krishna ate satisfied everyone.

Met with Yudhishthira's volley of questions at Hastinapura, Arjuna is lost for words; with heavy breathing he finally says Krishna has left this earth.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:57 (auto-transcript): “he didn't know what to say and then eventually with heavy breathing Arjuna broke the news to Yudhishthir Maharaj that Lord Krishna is no longer present on this earth that he has left them alone and so we find that Arjuna is recollecting All the various times that Lord Krishna…”

He has been recounting each rescue: Draupadi in the assembly, the defeat of Jarasandha, conquering Indra while protecting Maya Danava, helping Agni consume the Khandava forest, and winning Draupadi's hand.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:30 (auto-transcript): “All the various times that Lord Krishna saved them In yesterday's verse He mentioned that How Lord Krishna saved Draupadi In the vicious assembly How Lord Krishna in the previous verses He also mentions that How he saved them from Jarasand Who was such a big king With so much…”

🎙 Prabhu at 11:12 (auto-transcript): “when the Pandavas lost the dice match they were exiled for 12 years into the forest with one year additional to be incognito and if they were caught in that one year where they are supposed to hide they were supposed to live incognito if they were found out then they would…”

Brahmanas and guests followed them into the forest, and Yudhishthira worried how to feed them with only roots and fruits. He asked the family priest Dhaumya for a solution.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:48 (auto-transcript): “The Pandavas were exiled to the forest but when the Pandavas proceeded to the forest then along with them many brahmanas also went and other guests also went and Yudhishthir Maharaj was very worried because he is travelling with this entourage and they were in the forest. Dhaumya advised approaching the sun-god, who is in charge of food. Yudhishthira stood in the water chanting Surya's names for many days until he appeared and gave a copper vessel that never runs out.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:55 (auto-transcript): “so Dhomya he suggested to Yudhishthir Maharaj he said my dear king please let us approach the sun god Suryadev he feeds everyone he is in charge of food so please let us approach Suryadev and Yudhishthir Maharaj asked what is it that he needs to do the process of getting…”

🎙 Prabhu at 15:03 (auto-transcript): “But There are two conditions One that you have to feed the guests first then you eat and number two after Draupadi has eaten that vessel will stop producing food until the next day so make sure Draupadi is the last one to eat and so Yudhishya Maharaj having received this gift…”

Hearing of the vessel, Duryodhana wanted it stopped. He knew Durvasa, an expansion of Lord Shiva, is easy to please and quick to anger.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:14 (auto-transcript): “so Mahabharat mentions Duryodhan He had known about Durvasamuni As we read in the paper Durvasamuni He is very easy to please And also very quick to anger Because he is a Representation Or an expansion of Lord Shiva When Atrimuni Was praying To the supreme creator He did not…”

Atri prayed to 'the controller' without saying which, and Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva all came. His wife Anasuya fed them and asked for sons like them: Soma from Brahma, Durvasa from Shiva and Dattatreya from Vishnu.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:43 (auto-transcript): “When Atrimuni Was praying To the supreme creator He did not specify Who he wanted to come there he was talking about the controller he didn't say supreme controller he said I want to have audience with the controller and so three people came there Lord Brahma, Lord Vishnu and…”

Duryodhana invited Durvasa and his ten thousand disciples to accept his service.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:25 (auto-transcript): “So Duryodhana knew Durvasa Muni can be pleased very easily and can also be very quick to anger. He made sure no one made the slightest mistake in reception or feeding, and the pleased sage offered a blessing.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:41 (auto-transcript): “And Duryodhana made sure everything was perfect. All the arrangements, the reception, the feeding, he made sure nobody anywhere made a mistake to displease Durvasamuni. And so after the whole feeding program and everything was over, Durvasamuni was there with his 10,000…”

Feigning sadness, he asked Durvasa to visit his worshipable eldest brother in the forest — but in the evening, after the Pandavas and Draupadi had eaten, so there would be no food and the sage would curse them.

🎙 Prabhu at 19:30 (auto-transcript): “want and Duryodhana said no I am just so happy you accepted my invitation you came and ate with us here this pleased me very much but I am little sad. Duryodhana said why are you sad? See you've blessed me and you've blessed our palace but I have cousins and he is our eldest.…”

He served great sages so nicely, yet because his intention was to destroy his cousins he never received any real blessing. — “Look at the mentality of Duryodhana.”

🎙 Prabhu at 21:30 (auto-transcript): “Look at the mentality of Duryodhana. He is calling a sage, he is inviting so nicely, he is feeding so nicely but the motive behind was, I want to destroy my cousin. So although Duryodhana served such great sages, but because the intention of Duryodhana was not proper,…”

Yudhishthira bought time by sending the sages to bathe; Draupadi found the vessel closed for the day and began meditating on Krishna, who at once knocked on the door.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:24 (auto-transcript): “And so when Durvasamuni came to Yudhishthir Maharaj in the forest, Yudhishthira Maharaj welcomed Durvasamuni very nicely. And Durvasamuni said, yes, I have come here and we would like to eat. Yudhishthira Maharaj, he wanted to buy some time because now they were in a…”

Krishna asks for food; Draupadi asks why He is adding to their trouble when they cannot even feed Durvasa. He asks to see the vessel.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:35 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna knocked on the door and then they welcomed him and Lord Krishna said ok everything else aside I am very hungry give me some food and Draupadi she looked at Lord Krishna and Lord Krishna said why are you looking? give some food I am hungry give me something to eat…”

Her tears were not about Durvasa's anger but that Krishna had asked her for something and she could not give it. — “this is the caliber of devotees”

🎙 Prabhu at 24:31 (auto-transcript): “Drupadi was crying As Prabhupada is mentioning Lord Krishna asked her for food and she couldn't give she wasn't so worried about what Durvasa will do she was worried Krishna has asked me for something and I can't give it this is the caliber of devotees the Pandavas wa and so…”

On the inside rim Krishna finds a grain of rice stuck to a bit of green vegetable. Draupadi is ashamed she did not even clean the pot; some acharyas say she asked Him to feed Himself with half and everyone with the other half. He eats it and says He is satisfied.

🎙 Prabhu at 24:52 (auto-transcript): “and so she brought the pot the Akshay Patra to Lord Krishna and Lord Krishna was inspecting the Akshay Patra and on the edge it had a rim so in the inside rim it's mentioned here Arjuna is saying shakha anna, shakha means green leafy vegetable and anna means grain. So there…”

In the river the sages start burping. Bhima, with full faith, goes to call them though there is no food; the disciples fear they will burst, and Durvasa sends apologies and leaves.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:10 (auto-transcript): “and on the flip side Durvasamuni and 10,000 disciples suddenly they started burping they were burping so much in the river and Lord Krishna on this side told Bhima please go call go call Durvasa and his disciples so Bhima looked at Krishna and like there is no food I am going…”

Prabhu tells other episodes showing both sides of Durvasa.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:15 (auto-transcript): “Durvasa Muni he is known easily angered and easily pleased easily angered Shala Prabhupada is referring to Amrish Maharaj. We all know the story. Amrish Maharaj broke his fast and didn't break his fast at the same time. But Durvasa got angry and he produced a demon that was…”

Angry with Ambarisha over breaking his fast, Durvasa created a demon to kill him; the Lord's Sudarshana destroyed it and chased Durvasa.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:28 (auto-transcript): “Shala Prabhupada is referring to Amrish Maharaj. We all know the story. Amrish Maharaj broke his fast and didn't break his fast at the same time. But Durvasa got angry and he produced a demon that was going to kill Amrish Maharaj. But the Lord protected Amrish Maharaj also by…”

Durvasa gave Indra a fine garland; Indra put it on Airavata, who threw it down and stepped on it. Durvasa cursed the proud demigods to lose everything — Bali took the heavens until Aditi prayed and Vamanadeva restored them.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:57 (auto-transcript): “Another time Durvasa went to the heavenly planets and there he saw lord indra and durvasa was wearing a very nice garland so he said oh this garland is nice garland i should give it to the king of the demigods indra and so durvasa gave his garland to indra but indra instead…”

Per the Garga Samhita, pleased with Radharani's cooking, Durvasa blessed her: no one will cook as well, and whoever eats her cooking will live long and healthy. Yashoda, worried about demons, asked that she cook for Krishna daily; acharyas say she never repeats a preparation.

🎙 Prabhu at 30:44 (auto-transcript): “Garga Samitha mentions Durvasa once went to Vraja and he went to the house of Kirtida and Rishabhanu and there Srimati Radharani was there and she was the one told cook for Durvasa so Srimati Radharani cooked and gave it to Durvasa Durvasa ate he was so happy with the prasad…”

Prabhu notes some accounts are folklore rather than shastra: Durvasa, stuck in a river after losing his cloth, was helped by Draupadi with a torn piece of her sari and blessed her with unlimited cloth when needed — linked by some to her rescue in the assembly.

🎙 Prabhu at 33:42 (auto-transcript): “Durvasamuni there are many instances some are not so verified or in the shastra but folklore and traditional accounts they say they are associated with Durvasamuni one such incident is that Durvasa Muni was bathing in the river and somehow he was left without his kopins. The…”

Arjuna feels orphaned, yet even without Krishna's physical presence he is fully Krishna conscious, absorbed in how the Lord saved them.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:37 (auto-transcript): “However, here what Arjuna is recollecting is that not just with Durvasa, with all the incidences in their life, Lord Krishna always protected them. And so Arjuna is now feeling that our shelter, our protector is no longer there. We are left, abandoned, orphaned, without…”

children.topic: Please Him and all are pleased
children.note:
The Pandavas knew Krishna is the root of the world and enjoyer of all sacrifices, so their only concern was pleasing Him; trials barely touched them.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:53 (auto-transcript): “conscious and so they knew if we satisfy the Lord then everyone is satisfied. Just mean to stay Jagat Tuhtam. Lord Krishna he is the enjoyer of all sacrifices and austerities he is the supreme lord of all planets and demigods and so they knew if we please Lord Krishna then…”

As kings they fed so many out of duty, because common people follow great ones. They never worried — the moment Durvasa went to bathe, they called Krishna, and He came.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:19 (auto-transcript): “but as a duty and as to set an example because they were kings whatever great people do common men follow so Yudhishthir Maharaj out of his duty he was obliged to feed so many people and out of that obligation they got the Akshay Patra and this whole incidence was playing…”
Krishna says one who sees Him everywhere is never lost to Him, nor He to that person. Only devotees can understand how dear the Lord and His devotees are to each other.

Krishna sent Akrura to see how His cousins were treated; Akrura warned Dhritarashtra that the Pandavas had Krishna. Unheeded, the schemes went on, but Krishna protected them through all of it.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:04 (auto-transcript): “Were very very dear to the Lord He even sent Ankara to Hastinapur To check on them He sent Ankara and he told Ankara please go and see how my cousins are doing. And when Akrura saw the mistreatment that they were being exposed to from Dhritarashtra, he told Dhritarashtra…”

We are already dear to Krishna; we have forgotten how dear He is to us, and devotional service revives it.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:01 (auto-transcript): “Our focus is how can we become in that position that Lord Krishna is the most dear to us. We are already dear to Krishna. We have forgotten how dear Krishna is to us. And so through the process of devotional service, we can revive this relationship again and make Lord Krishna…”

🎙 Prabhu at 42:36 (auto-transcript): “Everyone holds so many things dear to them. Nowadays, the most dear thing is the mobile phone. We have to protect it at all costs. When a mobile phone is lost, people come into this position of Arjuna. They don't know how to function, they don't know what to do. But through…”

Srila Prabhupada explains we love the body because we sit in it, and we are part of Krishna — so all our love is really love for Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:25 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada gave this explanation that we love other objects because of our love for Krishna. if we analyze everything even this body we love this body because we are here seated in the body and who are we if one meditates in this way I love this body because I am seated…”

Service attracts Krishna; when the tongue serves Him He reveals Himself. Two ways: eat only Krishna prasadam and chant His names.

🎙 Prabhu at 44:40 (auto-transcript): “The way to attract Lord Krishna is through service Right now we have so many dear objects Sarvopadi These are all upadi's designations But when we render service on to Lord Krishna With our tongue Then Lord Krishna reveals himself And he becomes very dear to us How do we…”

A question after the class.

🎙 Prabhu at 45:56 (auto-transcript): “The question is, there are devotees who go to eat at people's houses. So are these other people devotees or are they just members of the public? Is there a lesson for devotees who go to eat at people's houses?

🎙 Prabhu at 46:25 (auto-transcript): “Devotees don't eat at other people's houses. They eat at devotees' houses. That's part of the loving exchange. Not going to an industrialist's house just to satisfy the tongue; avoid overeating, as Mahaprabhu warns, and take only Krishna prasadam.
